product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an onboard autonomy operating system and fleet-management software that lets defense and commercial operators run and coordinate fleets of autonomous robots, including drones.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes AuterionOS as the onboard operating system for autonomous robots and presents its platform for managing fleets and coordinated operations.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers product information and a Contact Sales route; no public pricing page is linked in the navigation or footer.

named_customers.notes: The cited Auterion page explicitly describes these organizations as part of Auterion's global customer base; the separate DroneUp case study also identifies a customer use case.

employee_band.notes: Auterion's LinkedIn company profile states 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Arlington, Virginia as headquarters; Auterion's company page gives its U.S. HQ address in Arlington.

founded_year.notes: Auterion's LinkedIn company profile lists 2017 as its founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The Technology category includes technical-topic posts, but the index and examined technical posts do not show at least two engineering/build posts authored by engineers; one GPS-denied navigation post identifies an Auterion Computer Vision Engineer, while other checked posts have no engineer byline.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site contains multiple product-operation, developer, hardware-integration, system-guide, and release-note sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The currently listed openings include Computer Vision Engineer and Senior Computer Vision Engineer roles.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed Auterion product documentation, its AI-related technical post, and the subprocessor statement; none publicly identifies an AI model or model provider used by the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The company's legal page lists its policies and terms but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Auterion announced a $130 million Series B on September 23, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2025 Series B falls within the 18-month period preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The listed live openings include engineering, computer vision, marketing, finance, supply-chain, and other roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Auterion announced the Nemyx Vertical Launch System on October 5, 2026, and an AuterionOS/HYDRIS integration on October 19, 2026; both are within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The press index shows leadership appointment announcements for Rob Rainhart in November 2024 and James East in January 2025, both before the November 9, 2025 start of the 12-month window, and no 2025–2026 executive appointment or departure; the company page lists the current leadership team.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A current RevOps job listing says the role owns the GTM stack including HubSpot; Auterion's subprocessor statement also identifies HubSpot for customer-fulfillment and marketing purposes.
